description: Export many nodes in one call, each at a scale or targetWidth (scale = targetWidth / node width, clamped 0.01–4). Files go to outputDir (default: a fresh folder under ~/.deskhand/exports/) named by namePattern with tokens {name} {id} {scale} {ext} {index}. One row per item (path and size, or an error); nothing is inlined.
name: figma_export_batch
